name: OpenMAIC
description: Multi-agent interactive classroom that generates a course with slides, quizzes and projects and teaches it with AI teacher and classmate agents.
whatItDoes: Turns a topic or document into an interactive lesson where agent teachers lecture and agent classmates discuss with the learner. Educators and learners use it to build and attend courses.
howItWorks: A TypeScript web app orchestrates agents that author lesson content and then play classroom roles in real time. It runs with a package manager or Docker Compose and reads provider keys from a local env file.

requirements.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
requirements.description: One provider key is needed; GLM_API_KEY and others are alternatives

models: Anthropic, GLM and other configured providers
